review.tagline: CLI and agent skills for spec-driven development, bug fixing and idea assessment
review.summary: Spec Kit is a Python CLI (`specify`) that scaffolds a project with slash-command skills for AI coding agents such as GitHub Copilot. Its core flow is constitution, specify, plan, tasks, implement, converge. Bug-fix (assess, fix, test) and idea-assessment (intake through decide) processes are opt-in extensions that write Markdown reports under `.specify/`.
review.audience: Developers who want structured specs and workflows for their AI coding agent
strengths: Three independent processes; bug fixing and assessment install separately via `specify extension add`
Artifacts are plain Markdown in `.specify/`, reviewable and editable by hand
Integration keys let the same workflow target different coding agents
Extensions, presets, workflows and bundles allow customizing or replacing the processes
weaknesses: Needs a separate supported AI coding agent; it does not run models itself
Skills are invoked in agent chat, with invocation syntax varying by agent
Process is manual and stepwise: each skill is run and reviewed one at a time
needs: Needs Python 3.11+, uv, a supported AI coding agent
